Tulu: Yenk thare beene undu Spotify-d shanthavaad uppuna paata paadule.

Tulu: Daddig paata kenere undu Spotify-d parath Tulu paatelen paadule.

Tulu: Budget nishchaya malpunard dumbe 250 koodi 375 lekka malpule.

Tulu: Homework malpare undu 18 guna 24 yeth apundu panle.

Tulu: Dosthulla bill paalu malpare undu 900-n 12-d bhagisale.

Tulu: 85, 90 bokka 78-n koodad yenna total marks lekka malpule.

Tulu: Unit convert malpare undu 45-n 6-d guna malpule.

English: Open chrome and search for todays news.

English: Open notepad because I need to write down some notes.

English: Open chrome before my online class starts.
Tulu: Online class suru aapinard dumbe Chrome open malpule.

English: Open the camera because I want to take a photo of the sunset.
Tulu: Surya buroline photo deppere undu Camera open malpule.

English: Close chrome after I finish checking my email.
Tulu: Email check malth bokka Chrome close malpule.

English: Open notepad and write down my shopping list.
Tulu: Notepad open malth samanuda list barele.

Tulu: Bejaratha vishaya undu bega Chrome open malth hathirada aaspitre naadle.

English: Take a photo before the guests arrive.
Open notepad since I need to save this phone number.
Tulu: Ee phone number save malpare Notepad open malpule.

Close all open applications because my laptop is running slow.
Tulu: Laptop slow aathundu maatha applen close malpule.

English: Open the camera to record a short video for my project.
Tulu: Project-g onji yelyada video thegeyere Camera open malpule.

English: Open YouTube and search for Tulu songs because I want to relax.
Tulu: Samadhana gollere YouTube open malth Tulu paatelen naadle.

English: Before I sleep, open YouTube and play devotional songs.
Tulu: Yedepard dumbe YouTube open malth bhakthi geethelen paadule.

English: Open YouTube and search for cooking tutorials because I want to try a new recipe.
Tulu: Posatha adige kalpare YouTube open malth adigeda video naadle.

English: Search YouTube for yesterdays cricket match highlights.
Tulu: Kodanda cricket match da highlights-n YouTube-d naadle.

English: Open YouTube when I finish my homework so I can watch cartoons.
Tulu: Homework poora aayin bokka cartoon thuyere YouTube open malpule.

English: Play the latest Tulu movie trailer on YouTube.
Tulu: YouTube-d posa Tulu cinemada trailer paadule.

Tulu: Yelle vaara parikshe undu machine learning padhapulen YouTube-d naadle.

English: Search YouTube for workout videos before I go to the gym.
Tulu: Gym-g popinard dumbe workout video-n YouTube-d naadle.

English: Open YouTube and play Yakshagana performances since my father wants to watch.
Tulu: Ammag thuyere YouTube open malth Yakshagana paadule.

English: Search YouTube for how to fix a flat tyre because my bike broke down.
Tulu: Bike puncture aathundu flat tyre sarpa malpunen YouTube-d naadle.

English: Search Google for the nearest hospital because its an emergency.
Tulu: Emergency undu hathirada aaspitre-n Google-d naadle.

English: Search Google for tomorrows train timings because I need to catch a train.
Tulu: Rail pathered undu yelle rail time-n Google-d naadle.

English: Google the meaning of this word because I dont understand it.
Tulu: Artha aathiji ee shabdada arthan Google-d naadle.

English: Search Google for good restaurants near me before we decide where to eat.
Tulu: Oota khachith malpunard dumbe Google-d yelle yedde hotel naadle.

English: Search Google for the college admission dates since the deadline is close.
Tulu: Kadaisi din hathira barpundu college admission dinathen Google-d naadle.

Tulu: Videsha-g popina aalochane undu exchange rate-n Google-d naadle.

English: Google search for the pin code of this area.
Tulu: Ee jageda pin code Google search malpule.

English: Search Google for todays petrol price before I fill my tank.
Tulu: Petrol paadnard dumbe initha petrol bele Google-d naadle.

English: Search Google for the symptoms of fever because Im feeling unwell.
Tulu: Meyyi usharidji jorada lakshanalen Google-d naadle.

English: Tell me about artificial intelligence because I have an exam tomorrow.
Tulu: Yelle parikshe undu artificial intelligence bagge yenk panle.

English: Explain photosynthesis to me before my biology test.
Tulu: Biology pariksherd dumbe photosynthesis bagge artha malpale.

English: What is climate change and why does it matter?
Tulu: Havamana badalavane danna bokka auda mukhyathe yenchina?

English: Tell me about the history of Tulu Nadu since Im writing a project.
Tulu: Project barevonde Tulu naad-da ithihasada bagge panle.

English: Explain how a computer processor works because Im curious.
Tulu: Aasakthi undu computer processor yencha kelasa malpundu panle.

English: What is the capital of Karnataka?
Tell me about the solar system because my son asked me a question.

English: Explain what machine learning is before my interview tomorrow.
Tulu: Yelle interview undu machine learning danna yenk theripale.

Tulu: Train pathered undu yelle kaande 7 ghante-g alarm deele.

English: Wake me up at 6 in the morning before college starts.
Tulu: College suru apinard dumbe kaande 6 ghante-g yennan lakkele.

English: Set an alarm for every weekday morning because I have classes.
Tulu: Class ithinard varada kelsa dina kaande alarm deele.

English: Set an alarm for 5:30 am tomorrow since I have to leave early for a trip.
Tulu: Trip-g bega popinard yelle kaande 5:30-g alarm deele.

English: Remind me at 9 pm to take my medicine.
Tulu: Marthulenge thinnere raathre 9 ghante-g yenk nenpu malpule.

English: Set an alarm for 6:45 because I dont want to miss the bus.
Wake me up at 4 am tomorrow because I have an early flight.
Tulu: Bega flight undu yelle kaande 4 ghante-g lakkele.

Tulu: Kaande nadapere kelsa dina kaande 6 ghante-g alarm deele.

Lock the door before I leave the house.

Tulu: Chabi ullai bukkude baakil unlock malpule.

English: Lock the door when I go to sleep.
Unlock the door since a guest has arrived.
Lock the front door after everyone leaves for work.
Tulu: Kelsag boyina bokka yeduru baakil lock malpule.

English: Check if the door is locked before I go to bed.
Tulu: Yedepard dumbe baakil lock aathunda thule.

English: Unlock the door because I just came back home.
Tulu: Itte illag bathede baakil unlock malpule.

English: Lock the door immediately because I heard a strange noise outside.
Tulu: Pidayi shabdha kenna thakshanane baakil lock malpule.

English: Is the door locked right now?
Unlock the door for the delivery person.
Tulu: Delivery korre baathinaayeg baakil open malpule.

English: Lock the door and confirm once its done.
Tulu: Baakil lock malth bokka confirm malpule.

English: Keep the door locked until I return in the evening.
Tulu: Baiyag yaan barpuna mutta baakil lock deele.

English: Unlock the door before my friends come over.
Tulu: Dosthilu barpuna dumbu baakil unlock malpule.
